# Wipe Disk

![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/language-C%2B%2B-blue?style=flat)

## Information

* In Windows, files that are deleted directly may be recovered by third-party software, even with Shift+Delete.
* It doesn't harm the hard drive; it creates a file and writes over the data, logically similar to downloading a large game.
* The generated file will be automatically deleted after the process completes.
* Focuses on cleaning the remaining space left after files are deleted.

---

## Scenario

* If you leave a company and have personal data on your computer that you don’t want others to see, run this software after deleting it to prevent recovery.
* Before selling your computer, run this software after deleting personal data to ensure it can't be recovered by others.
* For confidential files saved on your computer, delete them and then run this software for complete data erasure.
